pricing_text: Your request will cost **$0.08** per started 24 megapixels of output for every precision model. For example, an output up to 24 MP costs **$0.08**, over 24 MP and up to 48 MP costs **$0.16**, and over 48 MP and up to 72 MP costs **$0.24**.
notes: $0.08 لكل 24 ميغابكسل مبدوءة من المخرج لكل نماذج precision: حتى 24 MP = $0.08، 24–48 MP = $0.16، 48–72 MP = $0.24 (أي شرائح 24 MP وليس لكل ميغابكسل).
